field.name: STEP_TEXT
field.value:
<<bb>>Ultrasonic Stage I Clean<</bb>><<nl/>><<nl/>>Process Time: 5-20 minutes per piece<<nl/>><<nl/>>Prepare the ultrasonic bath according to the ratio prescribed in WI-0081. Allow the ultrasonic to run for 10 minutes before processing any material for water to outgas. This should be done each time the bath is changed.
Follow the steps in section 4 of WI-0075 for cleaning. Processing time will vary, generally between 5 and 20 minutes, depending on the piece of graphite. Agitating and rotating the graphite in the bath will help clean the graphite quicker. DO NOT submerge your hand or fingers in the ultrasonic bath while ultrasonic is running.
Be careful to not touch the graphite to the metal tank in order to prevent unwanted markings to be left behind on the graphite. The customer requires a uniform finish on each piece of graphite.

Use extreme caution when drying the flat graphite as to not concentrate the air directly at the graphite. Brace each piece of graphite between a flat surface and one hand while holding with an open palm at the top. Holding the air nozzle at a 45º angle to the graphite, dry each piece from top to bottom. Rotate the graphite to dry both sides.

Graphite rods need to be protected from one another with small bubble wrap. Thoroughly and carefully pack the ends of each box to protect rod ends during shipping.
